"Made for a head three times the size of yours."

Plants a Banner of the Argent Dawn in front of you for 20 sec. While it stands, each of your heals on an ally within 15 yards of the banner makes it pulse, healing up to 3 party members within 15 yards of the banner, the most injured first, for 254 to 258. The banner cannot pulse more than once every 2 sec. Enemies can destroy the banner.

You kneel in prayer. If the prayer is not interrupted, for 12 sec the cooldown of your Judgements is reduced by 33% and each of your Judgements bursts in Light, dealing 30% of its damage to up to 5 other enemies within 8 yards of its target.

You swear to protect a friendly target for 30 min. When it falls below 25% health, the Light answers your oath: a sacred aegis surrounds it for 6 sec, absorbing damage equal to 25% of your maximum health. Once every 2 min.

Blesses a friendly target with the Virtue of Tenacity for 10 sec. 20% of the damage it takes is stored, and when the effect ends the target is healed for the stored amount, up to 3980, plus 30% of your spell power. The second of the Three Virtues taught by Archbishop Alonsus Faol.

You recite the Litany of Faol and the spirit of Archbishop Alonsus Faol appears at your side for 20 sec. It echoes your next 3 healing spells, healing the most injured ally within 20 yards for 35% of the amount healed.
Fractures the enemy's mind, dealing 692 to 722 Shadow damage and reducing its casting speed by 30% for 5 sec.

Like the champions of the Gurubashi Arena, you rush 12 yards straight ahead through your enemies. Up to 5 enemies in your path take 75% weapon damage and have their movement speed reduced by 50% for 3 sec.

You hurl a whirling axe that flies 15 yards straight ahead, then comes back to you. Each enemy in its path is struck on the way out and again on the way back, for 50% weapon damage each time (up to 5 enemies each way).

Like Broxigar the Red standing alone against the Legion: for 12 sec, each enemy within melee range increases your damage by 3% and reduces the damage you take by 3%, up to 5 enemies. Creatures, pets and totems summoned by players do not count.
For 8 sec, you leave shadow flames wherever you walk. Enemies standing in them suffer 200 to 220 Shadow damage plus 10% of your attack power every sec.

Sends a wave of frozen flames 25 yards along the ground toward the target. Each enemy it passes through suffers 572 to 622 Frost damage plus 18% of your attack power and has its movement speed reduced by 50% for 4 sec.

Summons 3 vile spirits for 8 sec. Each one goes for an enemy attacking you (otherwise your target) and bursts on contact, dealing 780 to 880 Shadow damage plus 15% of your attack power to enemies within 5 yards.

Plants a seed of starlight in the enemy for 12 sec. Each of your Wrath or Starfire spells that hits it makes the seed grow, up to 5 times. When the seed bursts at the end, or if the enemy dies, it deals 300 Arcane damage plus 25% of your spell power to enemies within 8 yards, increased by 20% for each growth.
Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form

Ursoc lends you his hide for 10 sec, absorbing damage equal to 30% of your armor (up to 25% of your health). If it breaks, it deals 400 (+45% of your attack power) Nature damage to up to 5 enemies within 8 yards and forces them to attack you for 3 sec.

Leap onto the enemy, then onto up to 2 other enemies in combat within 10 yards of it, landing behind each one. Every leap claws the enemy for weapon damage plus 180 and applies your Rake, then you bound back behind the first target. Awards 1 combo point on the first target for each enemy leapt on. Requires Cat Form.

Calls a wisp from the grove to follow a friendly target for 20 sec, healing it for 145 to 155 every 2 sec. If the target falls below 35% health, the wisp gives its life to heal it for 1450 to 1550. The wisp has 10% of your maximum health and can be attacked by enemy players.

Calls forth a spectral double of your pet for 15 sec. The double fights your pet's target and repeats the attacks your pet uses on an enemy, on the same enemy when in range, dealing 50% of your pet's damage. Only one double at a time: a new one dismisses the previous one. Requires an active pet.

A carefully aimed shot worthy of Hemet Nesingwary's trophy wall, dealing weapon damage plus 600. Deals 2% more damage for each yard between you and the target beyond 15 yards, up to 50% more at 40 yards.

Places a wooden decoy in front of you for 8 sec. The decoy has 10% of your maximum health and every second taunts the enemies already in combat within 10 yards, except players and bosses. When it is destroyed or expires, the decoy explodes, dealing 700 to 750 Fire damage plus 10% of your ranged attack power to enemies within 8 yards.

Tears open a celestial singularity at the target location for 4 sec, a collapsing knot of starlight. Every second it pulls enemies within 10 yards toward its center, then it collapses, dealing 900 to 1000 Arcane damage to enemies within 8 yards. Bosses are not pulled; players are pulled only by its first pulse, and not while rooted, stunned or frozen.

For 12 sec, your Fireball, Pyroblast, Frostfire Bolt and Flamestrike set the ground ablaze where they hit for 5 sec, dealing 250 Fire damage plus 15% of your spell power per second to enemies standing in the flames.

Marks an enemy with the cold of winter for 15 sec. The next Frostbolt or Ice Lance you land on it while it is frozen, or under your Fingers of Frost, shatters the mark, dealing 800 to 1000 Frost damage plus 40% of your spell power to it and to up to 4 other enemies within 8 yards.
Increases melee, ranged, and spell casting speed by 30% for all party and raid members.  Lasts 40 sec.
After the completion of this effect, those affected will become Chronally Displaced and unable to benefit from Chronal Surge, Heroism or Bloodlust again for 10 min.

Marks the target with a Ravenholdt contract for 20 sec: it takes 15% more damage from your poisons. If it dies while marked and yields experience or honor (summoned creatures excluded), the contract is fulfilled: you regain 25 energy and the remaining cooldown of your Vanish is reduced by 60 sec, no more than once every 2 min.

Throws a spare knife at the enemy for 190 to 210 physical damage plus 25% of your attack power. The knife then ricochets to up to 2 other nearby enemies, dealing the same damage. Awards 1 combo point on the first target.

A shadow copy of you follows you for 15 sec. Each of your damaging finishing moves is echoed by your double, dealing 40% of its damage to the target as Shadow damage (30% against players). Stealth and Vanish dismiss the double.

A gust of storm energy lashes the target and the 4 enemies nearest to it within 8 yards, dealing 625 to 685 Nature damage and dazing them: their movement speed is reduced by 30% for 4 sec. Maelstrom Weapon also reduces its cast time.

Marks the target with the fury of Al'Akir for 15 sec. Your melee attacks against it have a 20% chance to call down lightning on it and on the nearest other enemy within 8 yards, dealing 200 to 210 Nature damage to each. Cannot occur more than once per sec.

Heals a friendly target for 1110 to 1310 plus 80% of your spell power. 50% of the healing that exceeds the target's missing health flows to the most injured member of your party within 20 yards of it, never more than 50% of the heal.

Chains the target to the nearest other enemy within 15 yards for 12 sec. 20% of the periodic damage you deal to either of them is also dealt to the other, up to 400 per hit. If the hooked enemy dies or moves away, the chains hook the nearest other one; if the chained target dies, the chains move to the hooked enemy.

Gives the target to your demon for 15 sec: it attacks it and deals it 25% more damage. If the prey dies during the hunt and yields experience or honor, your demon devours its soul: you gain a Soul Shard and 15% of your mana, and your demon regains 30% of its health.
Splits the ground at the target location. After 2 sec the rift erupts, dealing 900 to 1100 Fire damage to enemies within 6 yards.

You have specialized in cutting gems. Your Northrend rare, epic, meta and prismatic cuts have a 15% chance to yield an additional gem, and you can cut the two-coloured Dragon's Eyes, the Starlight Prism, the Titan meta diamonds and the Eternity Shards.

You have specialized in crafting jewelry. You can craft the Runed Titanium jewelry, the Northrend figurines and the item level 264 rings and necklaces, and the jewelry and figurines you craft, those of Northrend included, are 50% more likely to come out of a higher quality.

You have specialized in weapon enchantments: you can learn the weapon enchanter's formulas, have a 10% chance to create an additional scroll when enchanting a vellum, a 5% chance to create a master scroll of your exclusive enchantments, and a 15% chance to gain an additional material when disenchanting weapons.

You have specialized in armor enchantments: you can learn the armor enchanter's formulas, have a 10% chance to create an additional scroll when enchanting a vellum, a 5% chance to create a master scroll of your exclusive enchantments, and a 15% chance to gain an additional material when disenchanting armor.
You have specialized in group feasts: a feast for every role, a 10% chance of an extra feast, and a 10% chance of a memorable feast whose meal lasts 2 hours.
You have specialized in individual dishes: hybrid dishes, a 15% chance of 1 to 3 extra Northrend dishes, and a 10% chance of a perfect dish whose effect lasts 2 hours.

You have specialized in glyphs. Your glyph recipes have a 15% chance to yield an additional glyph, you can perform Glyphist's Research each day in addition to Northrend Inscription Research, and you can inscribe the glyphists' master's inscriptions on your shoulders: Triumph and Dominance, then one more at each raid tier.

You have specialized in tomes and cards. You can inscribe the arcane scribes' tomes, one or more at each raid tier from the Nexus-War Codex to the Deciphered Scourge Treatise, and the off-hand items you inscribe are 50% more likely to be of a higher quality. Every Darkmoon card you inscribe has a 15% chance to come with a second card, you can learn the Scribe's Draws, which inscribe a card of the deck of your choice, and your Northrend scrolls have a 20% chance to yield one or two more.
You have specialized as a field surgeon: the bandages of the Argent Crusade's manuals heal 20% more.
You have specialized as a field apothecary: the field kits' shared cooldown is 1 min instead of 2.
You have specialized in wrecks: twice as many sunken coffers and half again as many blue finds from Northrend waters.
You have specialized in Northrend's fish: twice as many rare fish of the zone and half again as many legendary fish.
Embroiders a sturdy pattern into your cloak, giving melee attacks against you a chance to increase your armor by 1200 for 15 sec. Cannot occur more than once every 45 sec.
You can only embroider your own cloak and embroidering your cloak will cause it to become soulbound.  Requires 400 Tailoring to use.
Transmutes Eternal Water and Eternal Air into a Frozen Orb.

Compiles the day's glyph studies, creating a random assortment of inscribed works. You are very likely to discover new major glyph recipes this way. Its cooldown is separate from Northrend Inscription Research.
Permanently adds 120 attack power and 15 resilience rating to shoulder armor.
Can only be applied to your own armor, and doing so will cause it to become soulbound.
Permanently adds 70 spell power and 15 haste rating to shoulder armor.
Can only be applied to your own armor, and doing so will cause it to become soulbound.
Permanently adds 120 attack power and 15 haste rating to shoulder armor.
Can only be applied to your own armor, and doing so will cause it to become soulbound.
Inscribe a random Darkmoon card of the Keepers, Blossoms, Stars, Gadgets decks.

Reduces the cooldown of your Hearthstone by 15 min.
The items you mail to the members of your guild arrive at once.
You come back to life with all your health, and your spirit moves 50% faster.
Your elixirs and flasks last 50% longer.
Summons the members of your group to you. Cannot be used in battlegrounds or arenas.
Brings the dead members of your group within 100 yards back to life, with all their health and mana. Cannot be used in combat.
Dig at the place the map shows.
Thul'gorah stares at an enemy for 4 sec, then strikes. The blow is split between all players within 15 yards of the target; a single target will not survive.
Whoever stands within 6 yards of the Violet Aegis takes 97% less damage from the Nexus Overload, but deals 90% less magical damage and healing.
Overloads the platform with the power of the Nexus, inflicting 100000 Arcane damage to every enemy on it. Those standing in the Violet Aegis of the Kirin Tor take 97% less.
Allows a leatherworker to make special dragonscale armors that are unavailable to a normal leatherworker.  Dragonscale armor is all mail armor.
Allows a leatherworker to make special elemental armors that are unavailable to a normal leatherworker.
Allows a leatherworker to make special tribal armors that are unavailable to a normal leatherworker.
Allows a blacksmith to make special Swords that are unavailable to the typical artisan weaponsmith.
Allows a blacksmith to make special maces and hammers that are unavailable to the typical artisan weaponsmith.
Allows a blacksmith to make special axes that are unavailable to the typical artisan weaponsmith.

Allows an engineer to make fantastic, yet unreliable gnomish devices. At level 80, the goggles you build, Northrend's included, are 50% more likely to be of a higher quality, and you can build the gnomish field deflectors and the Ulduar transporter.

Allows an engineer to make lethal goblin devices. At level 80, you make 15% more Northrend ammunition and explosives, the ranged weapons you build are 50% more likely to be of a higher quality, and you can build the goblin pocket shredders and the K3 dimensional ripper.

Allows the tailor to create an additional spellcloth or spellweave when that cloth is created. At level 80, the spellfire tailor also sews the Spellfire Wristwraps and the Spellwoven cord and bindings, and the caster's cloth they sew (spellweave, Ulduar, Colosseum and Citadel patterns) is 50% more likely to be of a higher quality.

Allows the tailor to create an additional mooncloth or moonshroud when that cloth is created. At level 80, the mooncloth tailor also sews the Moonlit Cuffs and the belt and cuffs of the Abiding Light, and the healer's cloth they sew (moonshroud, Glacial, Ulduar, Colosseum and Citadel patterns) is 50% more likely to be of a higher quality.

Allows the tailor to create an additional shadowcloth or ebonweave when that cloth is created. At level 80, the shadoweave tailor also sews the ebonweave of every season (challenger's cuffs, rival's cord, gladiator's belt, bracers and boots, warmaster's cord and cuffs), and the ebonweave they sew (robe, gloves and these pieces) is 50% more likely to be of a higher quality.
Allows an Alchemist to sometimes get greater results when transmuting materials.
Allows an alchemist to sometimes create an additional potion when brewing high level potions.
Allows an alchemist to sometimes create an additional elixir when brewing high level elixirs.
Allows a blacksmith to make special weapons that are unavailable to the typical blacksmith.
Allows a blacksmith to make special armors that are unavailable to the typical blacksmith.
